settings.hero_desc: A layered 3D shadow-box plaque with backlit LED detailing - gears, circuitry and themed artwork built up in depth, finished with your branding. A premium recognition or branding piece for receptions and awards. This LED plaque shows a futuristic vision of nature and technology working together instead of fighting against each other. We add your company logo to show your commitment to this vision.
settings.s1_body: More than a flat plaque, this is a layered 3D light box - themed artwork, gears, circuitry and your logo built up in depth and backlit with LEDs for a glowing, premium effect. Ideal as a corporate recognition piece, a programme award or a branded reception display that captures your vision in one striking, illuminated panel.
settings.case_body: Created as a recognition piece for Aramco exhibiton event, this futuristic 3D logo box captured the theme and branding in glowing 3D detail - a centrepiece that stood out far more than a standard certificate or plaque.
settings.case_quote: Stunning - the depth and the lighting make it special. It takes pride of place in our reception.
settings.prov_p: Throughout history, nature and technology have always been at war with each other. Brands that help nature along their journey deserve special recognition like this to set an example for the rest.
